title: CardioState-JEPA: Delay-Aware Cross-Modal Learning of a Shared Cardiac Representation
abstract: arXiv:2608.12944v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Electrocardiography (ECG), photoplethysmography (PPG), and phonocardiography (PCG) provide complementary views of the same cardiac cycle, yet existing cardiac foundation models are trained for a single sensing modality, leaving the shared physiology across sensors unexploited. We introduce CardioState-JEPA, a cardiac foundation model to learn a single shared representation jointly across ECG, PPG, and PCG, built on a physiology-aware joint-embedding predictive architecture. The model maps heterogeneous waveforms into a common token space, processes them with a single shared Transformer encoder, and learns by predicting masked latent cardiac states, placing the pretraining target on shared physiology rather than sensor-specific waveform appearance. To handle the temporal offsets between electrical, mechanical, and hemodynamic events, cross-modal prediction uses a learned delay aligner that matches signals at the corresponding cardiac time

translated_title: CardioState-JEPA：延迟感知的跨模态共享心脏表征学习
translated_abstract: 摘要：心电图（ECG）、光电容积脉搏波（PPG）和心音图（PCG）提供了同一心动周期的互补视角，然而现有的心脏基础模型仅针对单一传感模态进行训练，未利用跨传感器间的共享生理信息。我们提出了CardioState-JEPA，一种心脏基础模型，旨在跨ECG、PPG和PCG联合学习单一共享表征，其基于生理感知的联合嵌入预测架构构建。该模型将异质波形映射到统一的令牌空间，通过单一共享的Transformer编码器进行处理，并通过预测掩码的潜在心脏状态进行学习，将预训练目标聚焦于共享生理过程而非传感器特定的波形外观。为处理电、机械和血流动力学事件之间的时间偏移，跨模态预测采用了一个学习的延迟对齐器，以在相应的心脏时间点匹配信号。
tldr: 本文提出CardioState-JEPA，一种利用延迟感知跨模态预测架构联合学习ECG、PPG和PCG共享心脏表征的基础模型，以捕捉跨传感器的共同生理状态。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CardioState-JEPA, a foundation model that jointly learns a shared cardiac representation across ECG, PPG, and PCG via a delay-aware cross-modal predictive architecture, capturing common physiology across sensors.
